x: Kaziranga's protection began on 1 June 1905, when it was notified as a (proposed) reserve forest, so 1905 is the year books give. It became a National Park in 1974 and a World Heritage Site in 1985; 1950 is when the game sanctuary was renamed a wildlife sanctuary.
dispute: Most books: Reserve Forest 1905. Strictly: proposed reserve forest notified 1905, formally a Reserve Forest in 1908 (History of Kaziranga National Park, en.wikipedia.org).
source: web: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Kaziranga_National_Park (1905 proposed RF, 1908 RF, 1916 game sanctuary, 1950 WLS); PMF Species-PAN 03 (NP 1974, WHS 1985)
